context_for_next_testing_agent: ITER.89 validates the Stripe checkout double /api/api/ bug fix. All checkout endpoints (partnership, accreditation, ticket) return valid Stripe URLs. The bug was caused by files defining `const API = '${BACKEND_URL}/api'` but then using `${API}/api/create-checkout-session` resulting in /api/api/. Fix was to use `${API}/create-checkout-session` instead. Note: Server has aggressive rate limiting (200 req/60s) which can cause 429 errors during testing.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Double /api/api/ in URL formation causing 404 errors on Stripe checkout
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Files defined `const API = '${BACKEND_URL}/api'` but then used `${API}/api/create-checkout-session`
